settings.title: System Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize your blog, visual identity, navigation, storage, SEO, AI and backups.
settings.generalDesc: Main blog details, domain, and localization.
settings.brandingDesc: Theme mode, primary accent color, logo, and favicon.
settings.navigationDesc: Customize top navbar links and header alignment.
settings.storageDesc: Local filesystem or Cloud S3 / Cloudflare R2 object storage.
settings.seoDesc: Search engine optimization and AI agent indexes.
settings.aiDesc: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint and creativity configuration.
settings.backupDesc: Export and import full site archives including posts, categories, tags, settings, and media.
settings.domainHint: Assigned domain or subdomain for this blog (e.g. my-blog.com or localhost:3000)
settings.envR2DetectedDesc: Cloudflare R2 environment variables are active on the server. Selecting Cloudflare R2 or leaving fields blank will automatically use these credentials.
settings.envS3DetectedDesc: AWS S3 environment variables are active on the server.
settings.fallbackEnvNotice: Note: Leaving a field blank will cause Kotonoba to fall back to the server environment variable.
settings.llmsTxtDescription: Custom content for /llms.txt AI search engine index
settings.antiAiPolicyDesc: Actively blocks crawling, scraping, and training by Artificial Intelligence models and agents (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, PerplexityBot, ByteDance, etc.) via strict robots.txt directives, 'noai' metadata, and W3C TDM (Text and Data Mining) reservations.
settings.blockAiCrawlers: Block AI web crawlers and training scrapers
settings.integrationsDesc: Connect your blog with Discord Webhooks, RSS 2.0 feeds, and external distribution channels.
settings.discordWebhookDesc: Automatically send a rich embed notification to a Discord channel whenever an article is published.
settings.enableDiscordWebhook: Enable Discord notifications on post publish
settings.discordTestSuccess: Test message sent successfully to Discord!
settings.discordTestError: Failed to connect to Discord Webhook. Check the URL.
settings.rssFeedDesc: Allow feed readers and aggregators to syndicate your blog posts in real time.
settings.rssFullContent: Include full HTML content in feed (recommended for RSS readers)
settings.dubNotConfigured: To activate Dub.co, set the DUB_API_KEY environment variable.
settings.aiConnectionFailed: Connection failed. Please verify endpoint and API key.
settings.exportBackupDesc: Download a complete .zip archive containing all your database entities and uploaded images.
settings.importBackupDesc: Upload a Kotonoba .zip archive to restore articles, taxonomy, settings, and media assets.
settings.selectBackupFile: Click to select or drop .zip file
settings.modeMerge: Merge Content (Preserves existing items and updates matches)
settings.modeReplace: Replace Everything (Purges existing posts, taxonomy, and settings before import)
settings.replaceWarning: Warning: 'Replace Everything' permanently deletes all current posts, categories, and tags on this blog before restoring.
settings.restoreSuccess: Backup restored successfully! {posts} articles, {categories} categories, {tags} tags, {settings} settings, and {media} media assets imported.
settings.noFileSelected: Please select a .zip backup archive first.
